Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَيَجَانِ الْحِرْصِ
Translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the surge of greed

Arabic text: وَ سَوْرَةِ الْغَضَبِ وَ غَلَبَةِ الْحَسَدِ وَ ضَعْفِ الصَّبْرِ
Translation: And from the outburst of anger, the dominance of envy, and the weakness of patience

Arabic text: وَ قِلَّةِ الْقَنَاعَةِ وَ شَكَاسَةِ الْخُلْقِ
Translation: And from lack of contentment, and ill-temperament

Arabic text: وَ إِلْحَاحِ الشَّهْوَةِ وَ مَلَكَةِ الْحَمِيَّةِ
Translation: And from the persistence of lust, and the control of zealotry

Arabic text: وَ مُتَابَعَةِ الْهَوَى وَ مُخَالَفَةِ الْهُدَى
Translation: And from following desires, and opposing guidance

Arabic text: وَ سِنَةِ الْغَفْلَةِ وَ تَعَاطِيْ الْكُلْفَةِ
Translation: And from the slumber of negligence, and undertaking what is burdensome

Arabic text: وَ إِيثَارِ الْبَاطِلِ عَلَى الْحَقِّ وَ الْإِصْرَارِ عَلَى الْمَأْثَمِ
Translation: And from preferring falsehood over truth, and persisting in sin

Arabic text: وَ اسْتِصْغَارِ الْمَعْصِيَةِ وَ اسْتِكْبَارِ الطَّاعَةِ
Translation: And from belittling disobedience, and considering acts of obedience as too great

Arabic text: وَ مُبَاهَاةِ الْمُكْثِرِينَ وَ الْإِزْرَاءِ بِالْمُقِلِّينَ
Translation: And from boasting to the wealthy, and looking down upon the poor

Arabic text: وَ سُوءِ الْوِلَايَةِ لِمَنْ تَحْتَ أَيْدِيْنَا
Translation: And from mismanaging those under our authority

Arabic text: وَ تَرْكِ الشُّكْرِ لِمَنِ اصْطَنَعَ الْعَارِفَةَ عِنْدَنَا
Translation: And from neglecting to thank those who do good to us

Arabic text: أَوْ أَنْ نَعْضُدَ ظَالِمًا أَوْ نَخْذُلَ مَلْهُوفًا
Translation: Or that we support an oppressor, or abandon one in distress

Arabic text: أَوْ نَرُومَ مَا لَيْسَ لَنَا بِحَقٍّ
Translation: Or that we seek what we have no right to

Arabic text: أَوْ نَقُولَ فِيْ الْعِلْمِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ
Translation: Or that we speak about knowledge without having knowledge

Arabic text: وَ نَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ نَنْطَوِيَ عَلَى غِشِّ أَحَدٍ
Translation: And we seek refuge in You from harboring deceit toward anyone

Arabic text: وَ أَنْ نُعْجِبَ بِأَعْمَالِنَا وَ نَمُدَّ فِيْ آمَالِنَا
Translation: And from being impressed with our deeds, and extending our false hopes

Arabic text: وَ نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سُوءِ السَّرِيرَةِ وَ احْتِقَارِ الصَّغِيرَةِ
Translation: And we seek refuge in You from evil intentions, and belittling minor sins

Arabic text: وَ أَنْ يَسْتَحْوِذَ عَلَيْنَا الشَّيْطَانُ
Translation: And from Satan gaining control over us

Arabic text: أَوْ يَنْكُبَنَا الزَّمَانُ أَوْ يَتَهَضَّمَنَا السُّلْطَانُ
Translation: Or time afflicting us, or the ruler oppressing us

Arabic text: وَ نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ تَنَاوُلِ الْإِسْرَافِ وَ مِنْ فِقْدَانِ الْكَفَافِ
Translation: And we seek refuge in You from engaging in extravagance, and from lacking basic necessities

Arabic text: وَ نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ وَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ إِلَى الْأَكْفَاءِ
Translation: And we seek refuge in You from the gloating of enemies, and from needing to ask our equals

Arabic text: وَ مِنْ مَعِيشَةٍ فِيْ شِدَّةٍ وَ مِيتَةٍ عَلَى غَيْرِ عُدَّةٍ
Translation: And from a difficult life, and from death without preparation

Arabic text: وَ نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْحَسْرَةِ الْعُظْمَى
Translation: And we seek refuge in You from the greatest regret

Arabic text: وَ الْمُصِيبَةِ الْكُبْرَى وَ أَشْقَى الشَّقَاءِ وَ سُوءِ الْمَابِ
Translation: And the greatest calamity, and the worst misery, and the evil end

Arabic text: وَ حِرْمَانِ الثَّوَابِ وَ حُلُوْلِ الْعِقَابِ
Translation: And the deprivation of reward, and the descent of punishment

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ أَعِذْنِيْ مِنْ كُلِّ ذٰلِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: And protect me from all of that by Your mercy

Arabic text: وَ جَمِيعَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
Translation: And all believing men and believing women

Arabic text: يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
Translation: O Most Merciful of those who show mercy
